data.narrative:
Resilience is a Series D biotech company that has raised approximately $600M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies in Biotech & Health: Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B, Series C), Abridge ($5.3B, Series E), Chai Discovery ($3.8B, Series C), and New Limit ($3.1B, Series C). A public-comp anchoring method using three sector tickers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) with a median P/S of 5.6x could not be applied due to the absence of Resilience's revenue on file.

The peer-median method yields a $4.5B implied valuation, with the range spanning $3.1B to $10.3B across the four comps. This approach is most defensible given the alignment on sector and stage. Public biotech comparables provide context but remain non-actionable without revenue disclosure.

A triangulated valuation range of $3.9B (low) to $5.2B (high), centered at $4.5B, is supported by private-peer precedent. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory and clinical/regulatory progress, which are material value drivers in biotech but not quantified in available data. The wide peer range ($3.1B–$10.3B) also reflects heterogeneity in technology stage and market readiness within the cohort.
